nodes.label: seed.js
nodes.description: Database seed script for local development and testing. Populates the database with demo users, workspaces, goals, action items, announcements, and activity logs. Uses @team-hub/shared constants for consistency.

nodes.label: migration.sql
nodes.description: SQL migration adding 'iconUrl' and 'createdById' to Workspaces, and creating the 'Invitation' table for workspace onboarding.

nodes.label: migration.sql
nodes.description: SQL migration adding operational fields: 'createdById' to Goals, 'dueDate'/'completedAt' to Milestones, 'pinnedAt' to Announcements, 'mentionedUserIds' to Comments, and 'entityType'/'entityId' to Activity/Notification logs.

nodes.label: index.js
nodes.description: API server entry point. Configures Express, CORS, Socket.io, and mounts all major route groups (auth, workspaces, goals, announcements, action items, notifications).

nodes.label: swagger.js
nodes.description: Swagger/OpenAPI configuration. Defines the API spec, security schemes (cookie-auth), and shared component schemas (User, Workspace, Goal, etc.).

nodes.label: actionItems.js
nodes.description: Controller for Action Items (Kanban tasks). Handles CRUD, reordering (positioning), assignment notifications, and workspace-wide socket broadcasts.

nodes.label: analytics.js
nodes.description: Controller for workspace analytics. Aggregates goal statuses, weekly action item completion, and monthly performance trends.

nodes.label: announcements.js
nodes.description: Controller for Announcements. Supports rich-text sanitization, @mentions extraction, pinning, and real-time updates.

nodes.label: audit.js
nodes.description: Controller for the Workspace Audit Log. Provides paginated activity streams with filtering by type, actor, and date range.

nodes.label: comments.js
nodes.description: Controller for Announcement comments. Handles @mentions, capability-based deletion (own vs any), and notification dispatch.

nodes.label: exports.js
nodes.description: Controller for data exports. Streams Goals, Action Items, Announcements, and Audit Logs as CSV files.

nodes.label: goals.js
nodes.description: Controller for high-level Goals. Manages status transitions, ownership, and activity logging.

nodes.label: invitations.js
nodes.description: Controller for Workspace invitations. Handles token generation, email dispatch via SMTP, and the public acceptance flow.

nodes.label: members.js
nodes.description: Controller for Workspace membership. Manages roles, member removal, and ensures 'last admin' protection.

nodes.label: milestones.js
nodes.description: Controller for Goal milestones. Tracks progress (0-100%) and updates completion timestamps.

nodes.label: notifications.js
nodes.description: Controller for User notifications. Manages read/unread states and fetching the latest activity alerts.

nodes.label: reactions.js
nodes.description: Controller for Announcement reactions (emojis). Toggles reactions and broadcasts changes via Socket.io.

nodes.label: workspaces.js
nodes.description: Controller for Workspace management. Handles CRUD, icon uploads via Cloudinary, and hex color validation.

nodes.label: activity.js
nodes.description: Library for logging immutable activity feed entries. Designed to run within database transactions.

nodes.label: cloudinary.js
nodes.description: Integration with Cloudinary for image storage. Supports buffer-based uploads and publicId-based deletion.

nodes.label: csv.js
nodes.description: Library for streaming database results to CSV format using csv-stringify.

nodes.label: email.js
nodes.description: SMTP email client using Nodemailer. Supports fallback to console logging for development and rich templates for invitations and mentions.

nodes.label: jwt.js
nodes.description: JSON Web Token utility for authentication. Manages generation and verification of access (15m) and refresh (7d) tokens, and handles httpOnly cookie management with secure/sameSite defaults.

nodes.label: mentions.js
nodes.description: Regex-based extractor for user @mentions. Supports both sanitized HTML spans (TipTap format) and markdown tokens (used in comments and goals).

nodes.label: notifications.js
nodes.description: Core notification dispatcher. Persists notification rows and pushes real-time alerts to specific users via Socket.io. Also triggers email alerts for mentions.

nodes.label: prisma.js
nodes.description: PrismaClient singleton. Ensures a single connection pool is shared across the entire API to prevent connection exhaustion during development reloads.

nodes.label: sanitize.js
nodes.description: HTML sanitization wrapper using sanitize-html. Configured for TipTap content, allowing specific tags (span, a, p) and attributes while forcing external links to safe targets.

nodes.label: socket.js
nodes.description: Socket.io implementation for real-time features. Manages workspace rooms, user-specific rooms, and presence tracking (Map-based). Handles JWT authentication via handshake cookies.

nodes.label: auth.js
nodes.description: Authentication middleware. Verifies the 'accessToken' httpOnly cookie and attaches the userId to 'req.user'.

nodes.label: permission.js
nodes.description: Capability-based authorization middleware. Checks if 'req.member' (attached by workspace middleware) has the required capability from @team-hub/shared.

nodes.label: workspace.js
nodes.description: Workspace isolation middleware. Validates that the user is a member of the requested workspace and attaches the membership row (including role) to 'req.member'.

nodes.label: actionItems.js
nodes.description: Route definitions for Action Items. Scoped to a workspace and protected by capability-based permissions.

nodes.label: announcements.js
nodes.description: Route definitions for Announcements. Includes nested routers for comments and reactions.

nodes.label: auth.js
nodes.description: Route definitions for Authentication. Handles registration (including default workspace creation), login, logout, refresh, and profile management (including avatar uploads).

nodes.label: goals.js
nodes.description: Route definitions for Goals. Scoped to workspace, supports status updates and activity history. Nests milestones.

nodes.label: invitations.js
nodes.description: Public route definitions for Invitation acceptance. Allows public preview of invitation details via token.

nodes.label: invitations.workspace.js
nodes.description: Admin-only route definitions for managing workspace invitations (create, list, revoke, resend).

nodes.label: notifications.js
nodes.description: Route definitions for User notifications. Supports marking single or all as read.

nodes.label: workspaces.js
nodes.description: Route definitions for Workspace management. Includes presence, analytics, exports, and audit log routes. Nests members and admin invitations.

nodes.label: invitation.js
nodes.description: Email template for Workspace invitations. Generates HTML and plain-text versions with workspace accent colors.

nodes.label: mention.js
nodes.description: Email template for @mentions. Generates simple notification alerts with deep links to the relevant content.

nodes.label: .env.example
nodes.description: Example environment variables for the frontend. Includes API and Socket URLs.

nodes.label: jsconfig.json
nodes.description: Javascript configuration for Next.js. Defines the '@/*' path alias mapping to 'src/*'.

nodes.label: next.config.js
nodes.description: Next.js configuration. Enables PWA support, configures Cloudinary image domains, and injects environment variables.

nodes.label: package.json
nodes.description: Frontend package manifest. Lists dependencies for Next.js 16, React 19, TipTap, Dnd-kit, and Zustand.

nodes.label: postcss.config.js
nodes.description: PostCSS configuration for the frontend. Enables TailwindCSS and Autoprefixer.

nodes.label: tailwind.config.js
nodes.description: TailwindCSS configuration. Defines a premium design system with custom color palettes (ink, primary, accent), Inter typography, display scales, and motion tokens (glow-primary, lift shadows).

nodes.label: globals.css
nodes.description: Global CSS styles. Implements the root design system using CSS variables for light/dark modes, custom scrollbars, and reusable Tailwind layer components (surface, focus-ring).

nodes.label: layout.js
nodes.description: Root layout for the Next.js app. Configures SEO metadata, PWA manifests, and wraps the application in the ThemeProvider.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Marketing landing page. High-fidelity design featuring a hero preview, feature mosaic, and pricing/CTA sections. Uses Framer Motion-like CSS animations for a premium feel.

nodes.label: layout.js
nodes.description: Main shell for the authenticated experience. Handles auth state persistence, workspace fetching, and provides the persistent WorkspaceRail and header.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Dashboard entry point. Automatically redirects the user to their last active workspace or the first available one.

nodes.label: layout.js
nodes.description: Workspace-specific layout. Initializes real-time socket connections for the current workspace, hydrates notifications/presence, and provides the workspace sidebar/navigation.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Workspace overview dashboard. Displays analytics tiles, goal completion charts, and 'In Flight' vs 'Just Shipped' goal summaries.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Workspace announcements feed. Lists posts with pinning, editing, and deletion capabilities. Includes rich-text composer and reaction hydration.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Workspace goals management. Provides status filtering (Not Started, In Progress, Completed) and goal creation via modal.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Detailed view of a single goal. Displays description, status management, nested milestones list, and activity audit feed.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Workspace action items (tasks). Supports toggling between Kanban board and List views. Handles task creation/editing via modal.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Workspace settings for admins. Allows editing workspace name, description, accent color, and icon upload. Includes 'Danger Zone' for deletion.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: Public landing page for workspace invitations. Validates token status (expired/revoked), shows workspace preview, and handles acceptance for authenticated users.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: User login page. Uses the AuthShell wrapper and handles cookie-based authentication via the authStore.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: User registration page. Collects user details and automatically triggers initial workspace creation on success.

nodes.label: page.js
nodes.description: First-run onboarding page for new users. Prompts for workspace creation if no workspaces exist.

nodes.label: AuthShell.jsx
nodes.description: UI shell for authentication pages (login, register). Provides the layout and persistent branding elements.

nodes.label: TextField.jsx
nodes.description: Reusable styled input field for forms. Supports labels, hints, and error states with consistent design system styling.

nodes.label: ThemeProvider.jsx
nodes.description: App-wide theme provider. Hydrates the theme state from localStorage on mount.

nodes.label: ActionItemCard.jsx
nodes.description: Card component for tasks/action items. Displays priority color coding, linked goals, assignee, and due dates. Used in both Kanban and List views.

nodes.label: ActionItemFormModal.jsx
nodes.description: Modal for creating and editing action items. Includes fields for title, description, priority, status, assignee, and goal linkage.

nodes.label: ActionItemList.jsx
nodes.description: Table-based list view for action items. Provides a dense overview of all tasks sorted by status.

nodes.label: KanbanBoard.jsx
nodes.description: Interactive Kanban board using @dnd-kit. Orchestrates drag-and-drop movement of action items between status columns.

nodes.label: KanbanColumn.jsx
nodes.description: A single column in the Kanban board. Handles droppable area and sortable context for action item cards.

nodes.label: ViewToggle.jsx
nodes.description: Segmented control for switching between Kanban and List views. Updates the URL 'view' search parameter.

nodes.label: ExportButtons.jsx
nodes.description: Row of buttons for exporting workspace data to CSV. Gated by EXPORT_CSV capability.

nodes.label: GoalCompletionChart.jsx
nodes.description: Bar chart visualization using Recharts. Shows a 6-month trend of goals created vs. completed.

nodes.label: StatsTiles.jsx
nodes.description: Composite overview stats component. Features a large weekly 'Action Items Shipped' metric and a goal-status progress bar.

nodes.label: AnnouncementCard.jsx
nodes.description: Primary display for announcements. Features pinning logic, rich-text rendering, reactions, and threaded comments toggle.

nodes.label: AnnouncementComposer.jsx
nodes.description: Rich-text editor for announcements using TipTap. Supports @-mentions via a custom extension and workspace member hydration.

nodes.label: CommentList.jsx
nodes.description: Threaded comment list for announcements. Includes a mention-capable textarea for adding new comments.

nodes.label: ReactionBar.jsx
nodes.description: Real-time reaction picker and counter. Allows users to toggle emojis on announcements.

nodes.label: RichTextRenderer.jsx
nodes.description: Safe renderer for HTML content. Uses Tailwind Typography plugin for consistent styling.

nodes.label: LogoMark.jsx
nodes.description: The official Team Hub logo component. Vector-based with gradient branding.

nodes.label: GoalActivityFeed.jsx
nodes.description: Vertical timeline of activity for a specific goal. Fetches audit logs from the API.

nodes.label: GoalCard.jsx
nodes.description: Card preview for a goal. Shows progress percentage based on completed milestones.

nodes.label: GoalFormModal.jsx
nodes.description: Form for goal creation/editing. Manages title, description, owner, and due dates.

nodes.label: MilestoneList.jsx
nodes.description: Interactive checklist of milestones for a goal. Supports range-based progress tracking and removal.

nodes.label: MentionList.jsx
nodes.description: Portal-rendered dropdown for member mentions. Shared by TipTap and plain textarea composers.

nodes.label: MentionTextarea.jsx
nodes.description: Custom textarea with @-mention typeahead support. Coordinates caret position and filters members.

nodes.label: Button.jsx
nodes.description: Base button component with multiple variants (primary, ghost, contrast) and sizes. Supports loading states and icons.

nodes.label: CommandPalette.jsx
nodes.description: Global search and action interface (Cmd+K). Powered by cmdk and Radix UI. Provides quick navigation and creation shortcuts.

nodes.label: AccentColorPicker.jsx
nodes.description: Custom color picker for workspace branding. Uses a curated 12-color palette or raw hex input.

nodes.label: CreateWorkspaceModal.jsx
nodes.description: Onboarding modal for creating a new workspace. Collects name, description, and accent color.

nodes.label: WorkspaceIconUpload.jsx
nodes.description: Image upload component for workspace logos. Supports PNG/JPEG/WebP with client-side size validation.

nodes.label: WorkspaceRail.jsx
nodes.description: Persistent vertical navigation for workspace switching. Always visible in the dashboard layout.

nodes.label: useCapability.js
nodes.description: Core hook for RBAC checks in components. Reactively determines if the current user can perform an action based on their role in the active workspace.

nodes.label: api.js
nodes.description: Centralized API client. Wraps fetch with automatic 401 interceptors for JWT silent refresh and JSON/FormData handling.

nodes.label: realtimeBridge.js
nodes.description: Client-side orchestrator for Socket.io events. Connects backend broadcast events to specific Zustand store mutations (upsert/patch/remove).

nodes.label: actionItemsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for tasks. Implements optimistic UI for drag-and-drop movements and status bucket sorting.

nodes.label: analyticsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for workspace statistics and activity charts.

nodes.label: announcementsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for announcements. Handles pinning logic, sorting by recency/pin status, and real-time updates.

nodes.label: authStore.js
nodes.description: Global authentication state. Manages the current user object, login/register flows, and profile updates.

nodes.label: commentsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for announcement comment threads. Maps comments to announcement IDs.

nodes.label: goalsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for high-level goals. Coordinates fetching, status changes, and deep goal views.

nodes.label: milestonesStore.js
nodes.description: State management for goal milestones. Handles per-goal milestone list hydration and progress updates.

nodes.label: notificationsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for user notifications. Tracks unread counts and handles real-time delivery of new items.

nodes.label: presenceStore.js
nodes.description: State management for real-time user presence. Maintains a Set of online user IDs in the active workspace.

nodes.label: reactionsStore.js
nodes.description: State management for emoji reactions. Implements optimistic toggling with server-side reconciliation.

nodes.label: themeStore.js
nodes.description: User preference for UI theme (light/dark/system). Persists choice to localStorage and applies classes to document element.

nodes.label: workspaceMembersStore.js
nodes.description: State management for workspace membership and invitations. Handles role updates, removal, and invitation lifecycle.

nodes.label: workspaceStore.js
nodes.description: Global workspace list and active selection state. Persists the last active workspace ID for seamless return on login.

nodes.label: auditStore.js
nodes.description: State management for workspace audit logs. Supports pagination and server-side filtering by type or actor.

nodes.label: index.js
nodes.description: Universal source of truth for constants and logic. Defines the CAPABILITIES/ROLES schema, socket event names, and RBAC utility functions.
